evals.name: full-new-project-interview-first
evals.prompt: I want an app for my physiotherapy clinic so patients can book appointments online. Prepare everything so the AI in VS Code can build it.
evals.expected_output: Detects a new project and a non-technical user, proposes Full mode and starts the interview with 1 to 3 plain-language questions. Writes no files.
expectations: Does not write any pack file in this turn
Uses plain language without unexplained technical terms
Proposes a mode (Full) with a one-line reason

evals.name: lite-pack-format-header
evals.prompt: Small change in my existing Flask app: add a /health endpoint that returns {"status": "ok"} with HTTP 200, no auth, covered by a pytest test, using the existing blueprint in app/routes.py. I use Claude Code. That's everything; you can skip further questions, show me the summary and then generate the files once I say OK. OK in advance.
evals.expected_output: Uses Lite mode, still shows a validation summary, and when writing produces handoff/HANDOFF.md following lite-mode.md with the **Pack format:** 1 line, template order, ID prefixes from pack-format.md and a pack history, plus AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
expectations: Shows a validation summary before writing files
handoff/HANDOFF.md contains the literal line **Pack format:** 1
The header uses Mode Lite and Project Existing
Requirements have a Source column and edge cases use E-xx IDs
The file ends with a Pack history table with v1
CLAUDE.md has @AGENTS.md as its first line
Delivery mentions that handoff-implement, if installed in the IDE, will execute the pack, and that the pack works without it

evals.name: update-from-phase-report
evals.prompt: Here is the report the agent wrote in handoff/reports/phase-1-2026-09-03.md. Section 4 says it printed overdue tasks in red, not delegated. Update the pack.
evals.expected_output: Enters Update mode, asks for the current pack files, asks the user to confirm or reject the non-delegated decision, and shows a change summary for OK before editing.
expectations: Asks for the current pack files instead of working from memory
Asks the user to confirm or reject the non-delegated decision before recording it as a D-xx
Does not edit any file before an explicit OK on a change summary
